h: Two Levels of Shabbos and Its Hidden Gift

p: עַל פָּסוּק לָדַעַת כִּי אֲנִי ה׳ מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם
on the pasuk "to know that I am Hashem who sanctifies you"
HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to Moshe,
מַתָּנָה טוֹבָה יֵשׁ לִי בְּבֵית גְּנָזַי
"I have a good gift in My treasure house,
"one who gives a gift to his fellow
"but Shabbos is bound to become known;
its reward is not bound to become known."
To understand the expression regarding Shabbos,
that it "is bound to become known":
הֲלֹא בְּעֵת הַצִּיוּוּי עַל מִצְוַת שַׁבָּת
at the time of the command of the mitzvah of Shabbos,
is that not itself the informing?
And also, what is this matter
of the giving of the gift of Shabbos in Parshas Ki Sisa?
Was it not already given to them
the mitzvah of Shabbos at Marah,
However, one may say about this:
דְּהִנֵּה בְּכָאן נִזְכַּר בְּפַעַם רִאשׁוֹן הַלָּשׁוֹן
here, for the first time, the expression is mentioned,
and it is stated in the holy Zohar:
the upper Shabbos and the lower Shabbos,
that is drawn upon a person
and it comes through belief in the heart
שֶׁמֶּלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
that the King of the kings of kings, HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
stands over him and sees his deeds,
so that immediately yirah comes to him
(as written in the Hagahah at the beginning of Orach Chaim).
וְזֶה נִשְׁפָּע עַל יְדֵי קְדוּשַּׁת הַשַּׁבָּת
And this flows through the holiness of Shabbos,
כְּאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (יְרוּשַׁלְמִי פֶּרֶק ד דִּדְמַאי)
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said (Yerushalmi Demai, chapter 4):
the awe of Shabbos is upon him.
However, this is only on the outside,
and not in the inwardness of the heart;
as in the derashah of Chazal (Yoma 72b)
on the pasuk "Why is there a price
in the hand of a fool" etc. (Mishlei 17:16),
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בְּלִבּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
about one who has no yiras Shamayim in his heart;
רַק זֶה הוּא רַק בְּחִיצוֹנִיּוּת הַלֵּב
but this is only the outer heart,
but only in the revealing of his heart."
is when the yirah is bound
in the inwardness of his heart;
and this is the aspect of the upper Shechinah,
the aspect of "Binah is the heart":
"and his heart will understand, and he will return,
that is, he returns to the root and the source.
And about this the pasuk comes
after the matter of the work of the Mishkan,
which is the aspect of the lower Shechinah,
through the holiness of the place,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָם (שְׁמוֹת כה, ח)
as it says, "And I will dwell among them" (Shemos 25:8),
and it is the aspect of yirah
that is, there is yet a level
the aspect of the upper Shechinah,
in the illumination of the inwardness of the heart.
And about this it is said with the expression "tishmoru":
that is, the hope and anticipation of the person
to merit feeling in the heart
through the flow of holiness from above,
וְאָבִיו שָׁמַר אֶת הַדָּבָר (בְּרֵאשִׁית לז, יא)
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה הַלָּשׁוֹן
And about this our Sages, of blessed memory, used the expression
that is, the illumination of holiness in the heart
from the aspect of the lower and upper Shechinah,
when the heart feels the illumination of yirah
that flows into his heart from the holiness of Shabbos.
רַק מַתַּן שְׂכָרָהּ לָא עֲבִידָא לְגַלּוּיֵי
Only "its reward is not bound to become known":
"to know that I am Hashem who sanctifies you."
And holiness is the matter of separation;
that is, that even in matters of eating and drinking,
when one eats even for his own pleasure,
holiness is found in it at the Shabbos meal;
as stated in the name of the Arizal,
that on weekdays a person's eating for his own pleasure
when even what he eats for his own pleasure
And as stated in the Midrash (Devarim Rabbah 3:1):
in these words: "You sanctify the Shabbos

p: וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב סג, ב)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (II 63b)
and from it they are blessed.
הַיְינוּ שֶׁכָּל שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הָעֲבָרוֹ
That is, all the past six weekdays
with the entry of the holiness of Shabbos,
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made,
and behold, it was very good."
And in the holy Zohar, Yisro, it is evident
that the holiness of Shabbos shines forth
for there to be blessed from it
which allude to the aspect of
the upper Shabbos and the lower Shabbos;
as at the beginning of Creation,
the source of the six days
was the Shabbos that preceded Creation,
which is the aspect of Binah,
which preceded the world of building;
and the Shabbos after the six days
is the aspect of the lower Shabbos,
שֶׁנִּכְלָל בּוֹ כָּל שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁעָבְרוּ
in which are included all the six days that passed,
as it says, "and behold, it was very good."
נִכְלָל בּוֹ קְדוּשַּׁת שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁעָבְרוּ
is included the holiness of the six days that passed,
in the aspect of the lower Shabbos;
and it is also the source
in the aspect of the upper Shabbos.
in whose following weekdays there falls
and also the time of Mattan Torah
that Rosh Chodesh is called "more holy"
comes from the arousal from below;
therefore, from the side of man,
"And it shall be, from one New Moon to the next" etc.,
יָבֹא כָל בָּשָׂר לְהִשְׁתַּחֲווֹת (יְשַׁעְיָה סו, כג)
"all flesh shall come to bow down" (Yeshayahu 66:23)
that is, from the side of man
New Moon is mentioned before Shabbos.
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר מַדּוּעַ אַתְּ הוֹלֶכֶת אֵלָיו וְגוֹ׳
where it says, "Why are you going to him" etc.,
שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן מִצַּד הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּת אָדָם
which is also from the side of human effort,
לֹא חֹדֶשׁ וְלֹא שַׁבָּת (מְלָכִים ב ד, כג)
"It is neither New Moon nor Shabbos" (Melachim II 4:23):
from the side of the arousal of man, as mentioned above.
And when there occur in the six weekdays
the holiness of Rosh Chodesh and a festival,
of the holiness of the arousal from below
of the holy days that follow.
